Name: QuickShop
Author: Enaium
Description:
# QuickShop
Open shop quickly
## Install
1. [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).
2. Install [this mod](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/864170-quickshop).
3. Install [EnaiumToolKit](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/863959-enaiumtoolkit).
4. Run the game using SMAPI.
